slides.headline: AI TOOLS *you didn't know about*
slides.body: Six of them, quietly running real work right now.
slides.close: You've heard of maybe two. *Number 3 is the one that breaks people.*

slides.headline: ELEVENLABS *clones your voice*
slides.body: Record about a minute of yourself talking. It builds a copy of your voice, then reads anything you type in it. Your accent, your pacing, the way you pause.
slides.close: Then it speaks Spanish and Japanese in that voice. *Languages you have never spoken.*

slides.headline: NOTEBOOKLM MAKES *a podcast about you*
slides.body: Upload your notes, your PDFs, a messy folder of research. Hit audio overview and two hosts start discussing your files, with tangents and interruptions like a real show.
slides.close: A podcast about documents *only you have ever read*.

slides.headline: LOVABLE *builds the whole app*
slides.body: Type what you want in plain English. It writes the code, builds the pages, sets up the database, puts the thing on the internet, and hands you a working link.
slides.close: People are launching real products from their phone. *No editor, no server, no code.*

slides.headline: CURSOR *writes code with you*
slides.body: A real code editor with AI wired into every keystroke. It reads your entire project before it touches anything, so what it writes matches the code you already have.
slides.close: One sentence from you and it edits *nine files at once*.

slides.headline: N8N *wires your apps together*
slides.body: Drag boxes onto a canvas and draw lines between them. Now a form fills your spreadsheet, sends the email, and texts your phone without you being there.
slides.close: It runs while you sleep and *you never wrote a line of code*.

slides.headline: FIGMA *builds it while you watch*
slides.body: The design tool every company already uses. Describe a screen and it generates a real layout you can click through, not a flat picture of one.
slides.close: The distance between an idea and something you can tap *is basically gone*.

slides.headline: COMMENT *STACK*
slides.body: I will send you all six with the links and which ones have a real free tier you can use today.
slides.close: No email needed. Save this and *send it to whoever keeps asking what to learn*.
